products.name: Saunf Ark
products.desc: A traditional Ayurvedic extract of fennel seeds that aids digestion and provides a cooling effect.
products.howto: Add a few drops to a little water and take after meals, or as directed.

products.name: Clove Oil
products.desc: An Ayurvedic remedy known for analgesic and antimicrobial properties that support oral hygiene.
products.howto: Apply a drop to the affected tooth or gum using clean cotton. Use sparingly. For oral/external use.

products.name: Adulsa Cough Syrup
products.desc: A herbal remedy with Adhatoda vasica (Malabar nut), known for its expectorant and anti-inflammatory action.
products.howto: Adults: 2 teaspoons two to three times a day. Children: 1 teaspoon, or as directed by a physician.

products.name: Kofyx Cough Syrup
products.desc: A premium sugar-free herbal cough syrup with a menthol-honey flavour that soothes the throat naturally.
products.howto: Adults: 2 teaspoons (10 ml) two to three times a day. Children: 1 teaspoon, or as directed by a physician.

products.name: Shatavari Kalpa
products.desc: An Ayurvedic formulation from Shatavari root, valued for promoting women's health, fertility and hormonal balance.

products.name: Gulkand
products.desc: A sweet preserve of rose petals used in Ayurveda for its cooling and rejuvenating qualities.
products.howto: Take 1 teaspoon once or twice daily, on its own or stirred into a glass of milk.

products.name: Rose Water

products.howto: Apply to clean skin with a cotton pad as a toner, or spritz lightly through the day.

products.name: Skin MD Body Lotion
products.desc: An Ayurvedic body lotion with aloe vera, cucumber extract and vitamin E to nourish and protect skin.
products.howto: Apply evenly to clean skin as needed, especially after bathing.

products.name: White Petroleum Jelly
products.desc: A pure white petroleum jelly that locks in moisture and forms a protective barrier for the skin.
products.howto: Apply a thin layer to dry or rough areas as needed.

products.name: Mahanarayan Oil
products.desc: A traditional Ayurvedic massage oil with Ashwagandha, ginger and sesame oil, known to soothe joints.

products.name: Pranafuel Hair Growth Serum
products.desc: A natural topical serum with Gotu Kola, Bakuchi, Palasha and Satavari to stimulate follicles and thicker hair.
products.howto: Apply a few drops directly to the scalp and massage gently. Leave on. Use daily, or as directed, for best results.

products.name: Pranafuel Bio Hair Oil
products.desc: A nourishing Ayurvedic blend with Bhringraj, Amla and Brahmi, with a plant-derived biotin booster.
products.howto: Massage into the scalp and hair, leave for 1–2 hours or overnight, then wash off. Use 2–3 times a week.

products.name: Gray to Black Hair Oil

products.howto: Massage into the scalp regularly, leave on, then wash. Use consistently over time for best results.

products.name: Ambehalad Churna

products.name: Amla Churna

products.howto: Mix ½–1 teaspoon in water, once daily, preferably in the morning.

products.name: Jyeshthamadha Churna
products.desc: A traditional Ayurvedic powder from licorice root that supports respiratory and digestive health.

products.name: Ashwagandha Churna
products.desc: A powdered form of the traditional Ashwagandha root, known for its adaptogenic, stress-relieving properties.
products.howto: Mix ½–1 teaspoon in warm milk or water, once or twice daily, preferably after meals.

products.name: Dikamali Churna
products.desc: A natural gum-resin from Gardenia gummifera, traditionally used to soothe teething in infants.
products.howto: Use for infants strictly as directed on the label and under the guidance of a paediatrician.

products.name: Rapsco's Balm
products.desc: An extra-strong herbal balm for fast relief from headaches, muscle aches and minor discomfort.
products.howto: Apply a small amount to the affected area and massage gently. For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes.

products.name: Rapsco's Rub
products.desc: A gentle rub that relieves cold symptoms with natural oils — soothes up to six cold symptoms.

products.name: Bahubali Lep
products.desc: A topical herbal formulation used as a pain reliever and anti-inflammatory for muscle pain and cramps.
products.howto: Apply a thin layer to the affected area and leave on as directed. For external use only.

products.name: Glycerin

products.name: Encounter X
products.desc: A fast-acting Ayurvedic formulation designed to enhance stamina, strength and confidence.
products.howto: Take one single-dose sachet with water about 30–45 minutes before activity. Do not exceed one dose in 24 hours. Adult use only.

products.name: Castor Oil
products.desc: An Ayurvedic oil valued for emollient properties that nourish skin, hair and the digestive system.
products.howto: For hair and skin, massage a small amount onto the area. For internal use, follow the directions on the label.

products.name: Boric Acid I.P.

products.howto: Use strictly as directed and per medical advice. For external use only. Keep away from children.

products.name: Sapta Agni Herbal Syrup
products.desc: A classical Ayurvedic formulation of seven digestive herbs (Sapta Agni) by Pranafuel, crafted to kindle the digestive fire and balance the gut.
products.howto: Take 2 teaspoons (10 ml) with water before meals, once or twice daily, or as directed.

products.howto: Apply a small amount to the affected joint or muscle and massage gently. Use as needed. For external use only.

products.name: Raayba Tooth Paste
products.desc: A pure Ayurvedic toothpaste for stronger teeth, healthier gums and fresher breath — formulated with traditional herbal ingredients trusted since 1933.
products.howto: Apply a pea-sized amount to your toothbrush and brush gently for two minutes, twice daily.

products.name: Raayba Tooth Powder
products.desc: A traditional Ayurvedic tooth powder for daily oral care — stronger teeth, healthier gums and fresher breath, naturally. Pure herbal formulation, safe for daily use.
products.howto: Dip a wet finger or toothbrush into the powder and brush gently. Use once or twice daily.

products.name: Shikekai Powder

products.howto: Mix 1–2 teaspoons with water into a paste, apply to wet hair and scalp, massage gently, then rinse. Use 1–2 times a week.

blog.title: Three Generations: The Rapscos Legacy Since 1933
blog.excerpt: How a single trusted remedy grew into a complete house of Ayurvedic wellness, carried forward by family.
blog.body:
In 1933, Rajmal Premraj Khatod founded Rapscos with a simple belief: that authentic Ayurveda, made to the highest standards, could care for everyday families. The name was officially trademarked in 1946 — and over nine decades it has become a household trust across Maharashtra and beyond.

From one remedy to a full range

What began with classical preparations now spans churnas, syrups, oils, skincare, hair care, baby care and more — every formulation rooted in tradition and refined with modern research.

Today, under the leadership of the third generation, Dr. Pritish Khatod, Rapscos unites that heritage with a GMP-certified, FDA-approved facility built for both Indian families and global export.

blog.title: Churna 101: How Ayurvedic Powders Support Daily Wellness
blog.excerpt: Amla, Ashwagandha, Ambehalad and more — a simple guide to using classical herbal powders.
blog.body:
A churna is a finely milled herbal powder — one of Ayurveda's oldest and most versatile formats. Taken with warm water, milk or honey, churnas are an easy way to bring the benefits of single herbs into a daily routine.

Our most-loved churnas

Amla for immunity and antioxidants, Ashwagandha for calm and strength, Ambehalad (turmeric) for joints and digestion, and Jyeshthamadha (licorice) for the throat and gut.

As always, follow the directions on each pack, and consult a physician if you are pregnant, nursing or on medication.

blog.title: From Herb to Shelf: Inside Our GMP-Certified Facility
blog.excerpt: A look at the automated filling, labelling and quality checks behind every Rapscos product.
blog.body:
Quality is never an accident. At our Nashik facility, every product moves through automated liquid-filling and round-bottle labelling lines designed for precision and hygiene.

Tested, every batch

As a GMP-certified and FDA-approved manufacturer, we hold every batch to stringent quality and safety standards — and build our formulations to meet international compliance, ready for global export.

It's how a 1933 promise stays trustworthy in 2025: timeless wisdom, modern assurance.
